summary: Surveyed all 21 in-scope files of this real-algebra/real-closed-field Lean library: the smallest file (Algebra/Ring/IsFormallyReal.lean), the two largest (SturmTarski/Utils.lean and PrimitiveElement/PrimitiveElement.lean), the two central hub files (RealClosedField.lean and OrderedAlgebra.lean), Prereqs.lean, and at least one representative file from every subdirectory: Algebra/Group/Submonoid/Support.lean, Algebra/Order/Field/IsSemireal.lean, Algebra/Order/Ring/Ordering/{Defs,Basic,Adjoin,Order}.lean, Algebra/Ring/Subsemiring/Support.lean, Geometry/Convex/Cone/Order.lean, RingTheory/Localization/Order.lean, PrimitiveElement/Quadratic.lean, and all five SturmTarski/*.lean files (CauchyIndex, JumpPoly, SignRPos, SturmSeq, Theorem). Every one of the 21 files holds genuine, substantial formal mathematics: real theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance declarations with full tactic or term-mode proofs, building up the theory of formally real rings, orderings/preorderings on rings, real closed fields, the primitive-element theorem, and the Sturm-Tarski theorem on real root counting, several citing external references (T.Y. Lam's 'An introduction to real algebra') and upstream mathlib PR numbers. This unit contains no lakefile.lean or other build-configuration file; all 21 changed/added files are library content. The declaration-keyword grep over the exact 21-file scope found 0 files without a theorem/lemma/def/structure/class/instance/inductive/abbrev/example/axiom/elab/noncomputable keyword -- every file qualifies as genuine content on that signal alone. The junk-signal grep found 0 matches. The TODO/FIXME grep found hits in 13 files (1-10 each); inspecting several of the highest-count files (IsFormallyReal.lean, RealClosedField.lean, PrimitiveElement.lean, Geometry/Convex/Cone/Order.lean, RingTheory/Localization/Order.lean) confirmed every hit is an ordinary developer note (upstreaming plans, mathlib PR cross-references, generalization TODOs) attached directly above or beside real theorems/definitions, not a junk marker on empty content. No exclusions: every file stays searchable, consistent with the prior review's disposition to retain the complete substantive real-algebra formalization.
